text: Found this gem while walking around and let me tell you, best decision ever to step in. Reception was amazing and friendly. The massage lady was just as friendly (haha we laughed about using bathroom instead of toilet, I forgot that it’s toilet in other countries). Honestly One of the best massages I’ve gotten in a long time!!! 10/10 would recommend!!! We also go some treats after soo the aftercare is a nice touch!!

Update - we came back the following day for a 2hr hot oil aroma massage and they again did an excellent job! They were very professional and ensured that we had a relaxing massage. The facility is clean and inviting. Highly recommended!

Also want to share that we also tried another popular massage spa nearby that garnered thousands of reviews (cozy) and it was a very disappointing experience. They talked the whole time. We will never go back there and disappointed in ourselves for trying it rather than coming back to Square.

My husband and I got the 90 min Thai massage and left feeling so refreshed and relaxed. You leave your shoes at the door and they give you slides to wear. You get a pre-masssage drink, then they give you a shirt and pants to wear during the massage, afterwards you get a hot drink and crackers. The ladies had the best pressure and did an amazing job, we both fell asleep. The front desk staff were friendly and helpful. They accept credit cards with a 3% fee in case you don't have cash. We will definitely be back!!

a comfortable and reliable place to relax, especially after a long day of walking or exploring. It’s a good option if you’re looking for a solid massage experience without anything overly fancy.

Highlights
• Professional therapists — pressure can be adjusted upon request
• Clean and relaxing environment
• Offers Thai massage, oil massage, and foot massage
• Good value for the quality of service
• Great for relieving shoulder and leg tension

Overall
The Square Massage is a dependable spot to unwind and recharge during your trip. If you need a break for your body, this place is worth considering.

Came here to relieve the tension in my shoulders and they went above and beyond to make sure all my knots are loosened. Very good service and the entire place is very clean and comfortable. Very value for money.
This place is good! The massage is very relaxing, the masseuse manage to press on my stiff points and release the tension which I needed. Overall good experience! Will come again!

Second time here.

They are warm welcoming at the first moment after you remove your shoes outside. They give you slippers once you entered the shop.

Tea and wet towel are offered and your feet will get cleansed.

This time I did a 2-hr Thai body massage with Thai herbal hot compress massage with 990 baht. The lady was very professional and kind. Her strength was at the point and she could feel and sense places where my body needs her energy to adjust.

It was such a great and relaxing experience. With soft background music that helps to unwind and I got a private room. It felt really nice! I wish I can come every day. Haha
Very zen, great full body oil massage.  I will tell my friends, family and anyone looking for a great massage in Chiang Mai🥰🥰👍 …

The environment is good and the receptionists are nice.
I chose oil massage and the therapist only touch me. She didn’t put any effort… 完全不到位. I felt very tired after the massage and I felt very disappointed.

Please be mindful of your personal belongings!!

We recently visited this Thai massage shop and initially had a positive experience. The massage techniques were quite good, and we were enjoying the service. However, during the session, one of the therapists stepped out of the room for about 7–8 minutes. At the time, we didn’t think much of it.

After the massage, when we wanted to leave a tip, we couldn’t find the therapist who had stepped away midway. Again, we didn’t think too much about it at that moment.

When we got home, we realised that 800 rmb in cash was missing from our wallet. While we do not have concrete evidence linking this to the therapist’s absence, we felt it was important to share our experience as a reminder for others visiting this shop. Please keep an eye on your personal belongings at all times, just to be safe.

This place did not disappoint! The service was professional and spot on! I enjoyed a 2 hour Thai massage for a very good price. It was clean, the pressure was perfect. I loved every moment of the massage. My body felt so relaxed! I highly recommend!

Came here few times and very enjoy the massage service. We booked the 1500 for two person for 90 min, which is way better than other place. Very clean and professional. Will come back again next time.
Had a great experience here. My family and I did full body massage. They gave great care. Highly recommended.
Tried the hot oil aroma massage. Reasonably priced and friendly service. Highly recommended!

I had such a pleasant and relaxing massage! I was really tired from traveling the day before, but during the one-hour session, all the fatigue melted away and my body felt so refreshed. The massage therapist was very kind and attentive, and I would definitely love to come back again.

Wonderful massages!! Hot oil, Thai with warm herbal compress, foot and leg… they are all amazing!
Staff is pleasant to deal with, very welcoming and great atmosphere.

This was an amazing experience. Traditions foot wash but with nice herbs and yogurt, milk, and salt scrub. The massages were very skilled and relaxing. Then to finish it off they offered complimentary Khaotan and bael fruit tea. On top of all that they offer one free item of select choices for filling out a review. The staff was extremely kind, polite, generous, professional, and helpful. Most also spoke very good English. Recommend 10/10 although more luxury than local massage it is well worth it and has some GREAT promotions for couples.

walked in and was greeted straight away with a welcoming service person. The interior is
clean and the service people
were attentive and not to mention massage was also wonderful. Thank you so much! Will come again if I have time!
Their therapist is incredibly skilled — I felt so deeply relaxed afterward.

Was pleasantly surprised to find this place just right behind my hotel, The Stay Collection. Without expecting much, it turned out to be the best massage I had in Chiang Mai. The masseur was strong, skillful, and applied the perfect pressure on muscles with soreness and stiffness. Priced fairly and worth every baht. Highly recommended!
very Comfortable  Environment kind workers. will definitely come back
The staff are kind and the massage was amazing! My friend and I visited twice during our four days trip in Chiang Mai.

Been here 4-5 times so far. In a neighborhood where there are 20 massage places within one block, the massages here (foot and Thai) have been consistently good. Nice ambience and staff as well. Highly recommend.

Spontaneously went here and they did not disappoint. The staff and masseuses are friendly, approachable, and are very lovely.
We did the thai massage and hot stone and I highly recommend, as it is relaxing and releases all the tension in your body. The prices are reasonable and you get a great service too!

The location is very easy to find. The service attitude is excellent, the environment is quiet, and the massage therapist has great skills. After the massage, I felt very comfortable. They also served hot tea. A wonderful experience.
The force is just right. Very comfortable. Beautiful environment. I like the private room for two people.

I visited twice while staying in Chiang Mai. I first went alone, and I was so satisfied that I returned a second time with a friend. I did the Thai massage + herbal ball course, and I highly recommend it. The staff and massage therapists were very friendly, and the overall atmosphere was calm and relaxing.

I recently had a head,  back and shoulders massage (1 hour) and it was a wonderful experience. The treatment was done in a private room with quiet, relaxing music playing in the background, which made it easy to unwind

The therapist was very professional, and the whole environment felt clean, quiet, and welcoming. The staff were also very friendly, which added to the overall comfort

The massage itself was excellent—firm, thorough, and exactly what I needed. I left feeling refreshed and relieved of tension.

Highly recommended!

I visited The Square Massage in Chiang Mai, and honestly, it was one of the best massages I’ve ever had. The place feels calm and welcoming the moment you walk in. The staff are incredibly kind, professional, and really know what they’re doing.

My therapist listened to what I needed, focused on the right areas, and the pressure was perfect the entire time. I walked out feeling lighter, relaxed, and totally refreshed.

The studio is clean, peaceful, and beautifully maintained you can tell they really care about their guests.

If you’re in Chiang Mai and looking for an amazing massage experience, The Square Massage is 100% worth it. I’d definitely come back!

I had an amazing experience with my massage! From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere was calm, clean, and welcoming. The therapist was incredibly skilled and attentive, taking time to understand my needs and focusing on the areas that needed the most attention. I left feeling relaxed, refreshed, and completely recharged. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a high-quality, therapeutic massage!
Excellent service and amazing massage! Very relaxing and worth every minute. Will definitely come back again.
Was walking around Nimman when I found this massage place. The place looked safe and inviting, that's why I chose it. I'm so glad I did. …

I did the full body massage which is amazing!!! The price is reasonable and the techniques are superb! Very close to ningman road so very convenient after shopping around. Their snacks collection is also a hidden gem. Highly recommend this place!

Fantastic massages every time! They were so kind and accommodating to my daughter that we kept coming back! Wonderful practitioners who works with all that hurts your body. We look forward to coming back again next year.

This is our families favorite place to get Thai massage in Chiang Mai. We go as many times as we can whenever we are in town. We’ve been to a few places in Thailand but none leave us feeling as refreshed, calm and light as The Square. You can tell the masseuse’s pay very good attention to what your body needs and are very professional. Couldn’t suggest this place more!

Best massage experience ever, the massage lady controlled the strength just right. I nearly fell asleep during the process, which is a good sign that I felt really relaxed and comfortable.

In conclusion, must come visit again during my vacation here!
Had an amazing experience at the square massage. I did the body scrub and hot aroma therapy massage. The place was clean masseuse was very talented. 😄 …
cozy ambience with soft zen music. Great massage! A place worth visiting.

First time in Chiang Mai and the first time Massage here. The environment is quite nice, and staff service quality is average above. I’d recommend here for you all as a tourist if you wanna relax in Chiang Mai during your trip!

First time here by chance, I just needed a quick relaxation around our hotel nearby Nimman . I tried foot massage and hot herbal compress ball massage. The therapist has a stable and firm hand. Good for my tired legs after a long day.
Great massage experience! The staff were friendly and professional, the location in Nimman is super convenient, and the price is very reasonable!
Confortable and relaxing environment, staff are nice and friendly. Recommended
I visited The Square Massage after seeing many good reviews. One thing I want to note is that they give you a herbal balm when you write a 5 star review. I wish I knew this prior to my visit. …

I visited The Square Massage and it was absolutely amazing. The staff were professional and friendly, the atmosphere was very relaxing, and the massage itself was one of the best I’ve ever had. I left feeling completely refreshed and recharged. If you’re visiting Chiang Mai, I highly recommend The Square Massage!

There may be slightly cheaper places around Nimman (so many!), The Square attracted us with its slightly more contemporary aesthetic. Service is great, couple packages available. v near the popular northern Thai restaurant and shops. Recommend.
Great - The bed for Thai massage has a hole for the head so neck don’t need to suffer. Good price too

One of the worst massages I have ever had. First time a massage made me mad. The lady had zero technique, like they were clueless how muscles work. Pressure was all over the place, so much that you get annoyed. …
A very lovely relaxing massage. Space was very clean, service was kind and attentive. Served cold tea as soon as we entered and warm tea and rice cracker after our massage.
Phenomenal massage! The atmosphere was peaceful and serene. My masseuse was very much in tuned with my body and applied the right amount of pressure and relieved all tension.

Chose the TS2 package for 800 baht. Was a fantastic massage at a great price. The one hour aroma massage was terrific, I almost dozed off from pure relaxation a couple times. The staff were also very friendly, relaxed, and professional. The space was clean, comfortable, and relaxing. Highly recommend

Chose this place after a long and tiring day of walking based on some amazing reviews we read online but had a pretty disappointing experience overall.
My partner’s masseuse was extremely rude, used some acupressure tool on his ankles that made his feet hurt even more than before - didn’t stop doing it despite repeated requests to reduce pressure. She was clearly distracted and seemed to be least bothered about the massage experience of the customer, the other masseuse had to keep telling her to massage properly.
We were very disappointed to have chosen to come here instead of our regular place (varalee). They did not even offer the standard stretching for back and neck that most places do post foot massage.
I think there are much better and cheaper places worth visiting in nimman area, not sure if I’m ever coming back here again.

Booked in for an oil massage for myself and my partner and was super happy with the experience. We received a sincerely warm and very friendly service from the moment we arrived. The spa was very clean and the massage hit the spot perfectly. Highly recommend!
Comfort and relax environment. We have a great massage experience here.
I had a great experience she really took her time on the stiff areas and worked the tension out without me having to point it out. Would definitely come back again.
The best massage ever! Relax and very enjoy time with this place. Recommend!!!

Tried this spot last year and will never go anywhere else now! It’s ao peaceful, you get separate rooms, and there are amazing masseuses - every time! Seriously the best. And the tea and rice crackers are great, too 😌 …

Very nice massage place - I really enjoyed a 2 hours package, the massager was very professional, perfect balance between strength and relaxation. Also I liked the ambience - the massage was in a separate room, nice interior design, clean …

So relaxing! We did the foot massage but the go all way up your lower leg and even your quads, which was much needed after all our adventuring these past few days. My calves were hard as stone and now I feel like I’m floating, don’t question it just come!

We were recommended to The Square Massage.  Reception was very hospitable. My Massuere gave a wonderful massage adapting and applying the correct pressure to my various pain response 😊

Relaxing massage. Will definitely come again. recommended!
Great massage with skillful staff  good location and good price

Not the ideal relaxing environment but very attentive service! The traditional Thai massage relieves my pain so much, perfect pressure! 2 hours with 3 different massages for less than 1K. A minor discomfort is the idle staff outside massage rooms gets loud from time to time.
I had a 2-hour course including head massage, Thai massage, and hot press, and I feel so much better. Everyone, please come visit if you're ever in Chiang Mai!
massage with Meu was simply amazing, clean facility and very kind people too. Even the tea they served was amazing 10/10, muuuch more worth the price
Best massage ever!! The lady who massaged me loosened up everything that needed loosening. Highly recommended :)
really really good massage, lovely people and a relaxed vibe!! 10/10
Good experience with professional message. The environment is cozy and pleasant.

Excellent! The staff speaks both English and Chinese very well, communication was no problem, and they were very friendly. The environment was very clean; the service was attentive and friendly, and the air smelled wonderful. We had a foot massage and a Thai massage, and the masseuses were all very professional and enthusiastic. If we felt uncomfortable at all during the massage, we could just let them know, and they would immediately make adjustments. Highly recommended!
Friendly service and reasonable price with truly private room. Great for relaxing after a long day in Chiang Mai. Would love to come again 👍🏻 …

It was very comfortable; you could just walk in. The staff were very friendly, offering welcome and closing refreshments. The staff spoke some Chinese, so communication was no problem. The price was also reasonable, and the set meals were even better.
Decent massage, great service. Room was a bit cold
Great first time experience of Thai massage! Staff was welcoming and friendly. Friend and I had a private room together which was a thoughtful gesture. Would consider returning!
The massage was excellent, very comfortable and the staff were very attentive. First they scrubbed, then I rinsed off, and then it started. The price was great, thumbs up!

I usually get massages in Hong Kong, but this was a special place to get one. I had a scrub and oil treatment for $1190. Mia and Kita were great, I've never felt so comfortable before. Good, highly recommended!
